command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== a diploid sample: two haplotypes differing at exactly 6 chosen sites =="
awk 'BEGIN{srand(29); b="ACGT"; s=""
  for(i=0;i<10000;i++) s=s substr(b,int(rand()*4)+1,1)
  print ">chrH"; for(i=1;i<=length(s);i+=60) print substr(s,i,60) }' > ref.fa
REF=$(awk '!/^>/{printf "%s",$0}' ref.fa)
POS="5000 5040 5080 5120 5160 5200"
rot(){ case "$1" in A) echo C;; C) echo G;; G) echo T;; T) echo A;; esac; }
H1="$REF"; H2="$REF"; i=0
: > truth.tsv
for p in $POS; do
  i=$((i+1)); R=${REF:$((p-1)):1}; A=$(rot "$R")
  if [ $((i % 2)) = 1 ]; then H1="${H1:0:$((p-1))}$A${H1:$p}"; GT="1|0"
  else                        H2="${H2:0:$((p-1))}$A${H2:$p}"; GT="0|1"; fi
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$R" "$A" "$GT" >> truth.tsv
done
cat truth.tsv

echo "== fixture identity: the haplotypes differ at the planted sites and NOWHERE else =="
NDIFF=$(awk -v a="$H1" -v b="$H2" 'BEGIN{ n=0
  for(i=1;i<=length(a);i++) if (substr(a,i,1)!=substr(b,i,1)) n++
  print n }')
test "${#H1}" = 10000 || { echo "FIXTURE: hap1 wrong length"; exit 1; }
test "${#H2}" = 10000 || { echo "FIXTURE: hap2 wrong length"; exit 1; }
test "$NDIFF" = 6     || { echo "FIXTURE: haplotypes differ at $NDIFF sites, expected 6"; exit 1; }
printf 'fixture_haplotypes\t2 x 10000 bp differing at exactly %s sites\n' "$NDIFF" | tee fixture.txt

echo "== reads alternating between haplotypes; 100 bp, stride 5, spacing 40 bp between sites =="
awk -v h1="$H1" -v h2="$H2" 'BEGIN{
  RL=100; q=""; for(i=0;i<RL;i++) q=q "I"; n=0
  for(p=1; p+RL-1<=length(h1); p+=5){
    n++; printf "@r%d_h1\n%s\n+\n%s\n", n, substr(h1,p,RL), q > "reads.fq"
    n++; printf "@r%d_h2\n%s\n+\n%s\n", n, substr(h2,p,RL), q > "reads.fq"
  }
  printf "fixture_reads\t%d reads / %.1fx total / %.1fx per haplotype / read 100 bp spans 2-3 sites\n",
    n, n*RL/10000, n*RL/20000 }' | tee -a fixture.txt

echo "== the VCF whatshap is asked to phase: het, and UNPHASED (0/1) =="
{ printf '##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n##contig=<ID=chrH,length=10000>\n'
  printf '##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype">\n'
  printf '#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tsample1\n'
  awk -F'\t' '{printf "chrH\t%s\tv%d\t%s\t%s\t100\tPASS\t.\tGT\t0/1\n", $1, NR, $2, $3}' truth.tsv
} > variants.vcf
echo "== the same sites with the PLANTED phase, for whatshap compare to score against =="
{ printf '##fileformat=VCFv4.2\n##contig=<ID=chrH,length=10000>\n'
  printf '##FORMAT=<ID=GT,Number=1,Type=String,Description="Genotype">\n'
  printf '##FORMAT=<ID=PS,Number=1,Type=Integer,Description="Phase set">\n'
  printf '#CHROM\tPOS\tID\tREF\tALT\tQUAL\tFILTER\tINFO\tFORMAT\tsample1\n'
  awk -F'\t' '{printf "chrH\t%s\tv%d\t%s\t%s\t100\tPASS\t.\tGT:PS\t%s:1\n", $1, NR, $2, $3, $4}' truth.tsv
} > truth.vcf
grep -v '^##' variants.vcf

echo "== align to the reference; whatshap reads phase from the reads themselves =="
bwa index ref.fa 2> bwaindex.log
bwa mem -t 1 -R '@RG\tID:s1\tSM:sample1\tPL:ILLUMINA' ref.fa reads.fq > aln.sam 2> bwamem.log
NREC=$(awk '!/^@/{n++} END{print n+0}' aln.sam)
NRG=$(awk '/^@RG/{n++} END{print n+0}' aln.sam)
test "$NRG" -ge 1 || { echo "no @RG SM -- whatshap matches the BAM sample to the VCF sample"; exit 1; }
printf 'sam_records\t%s\nread_groups\t%s   (assert >=1 -- whatshap matches @RG SM to the VCF sample column)\n' "$NREC" "$NRG" | tee -a fixture.txt
echo "ALIGN OK"
